seoTitle: Pool Builders in Greater Houston | Island Life Custom Pools
seoDescription: Owner-led custom pool builders serving the Greater Houston area, including Cypress and Tomball. Pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens planned in 3D.

blocks.imageAlt: Island Life custom pool and raised spa at sunset
blocks.intro: Island Life Custom Pools is an owner-led pool builder serving the Greater Houston area. We design and build custom pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens in Tomball, Cypress, The Woodlands, Houston, Katy, Spring, Magnolia, and Jersey Village.

blocks.label: Owner-led pool builders since 2016
blocks.title: Bring your vacation
blocks.lede: Island Life Custom Pools began in 2016 and is owner-led by Justin Hall. We design and build custom swimming pools, patios and patio covers, and outdoor kitchens for homes across the Greater Houston area: Tomball, Cypress, The Woodlands, Houston, Katy, Spring, Magnolia, and Jersey Village. We plan them together as one backyard, so the space feels like your own little island at home.
blocks.imageAlt: Freeform pool with a rock waterfall, a raised spa, and bubbling jets
blocks.caption: Custom pool & spa

services.title: Custom pools
services.description: A pool and spa designed for your property, your routines, and your idea of an escape—not pulled from a catalog.

services.title: Custom patios & covers
services.description: Shade, comfort, and architectural continuity, with custom patios and patio covers that make the outdoors feel like another room.

services.title: Custom outdoor kitchens
services.description: Cook, gather, and stay in the moment with a kitchen planned as part of the complete backyard, not added as an afterthought.

blocks.details: Complete the space with spas, fire pits, fireplaces, pickleball courts, and dependable Hayward equipment—all coordinated by one team.

blocks.title: Experience the ultimate
blocks.imageAlt: Covered pavilion with a stone fireplace across a dark pool at dusk
blocks.text: We give homeowners a place in the backyard to step out of the day: spectacular pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens that feel like your own island paradise. We work closely with you to capture your vision, then create a personalized design just for you.

blocks.label: 3D design
blocks.title: See your pool in 3D
blocks.intro: At Island Life Custom Pools we create a 3D model of your pool and outdoor space so you can see your vision come to life.
blocks.videoLabel: Video: the Island Life 3D design software in action

blocks.title: Experience the island life
blocks.imageAlt: Lounge chairs and striped umbrellas on a stone-edged pool deck at dusk
blocks.text: When you work with Island Life Custom Pools, our team crafts an outdoor space you can be proud of. We work closely with you to create the perfect home away from home in your backyard. We’re pleased to offer a generous discount for the military, first responders, and teachers. Island Life Custom Pools has received the Best of Tomball Pool Builders Award (2018, 2019, and 2020) and Best of Houzz 2020 (Service).

blocks.title: Google Guaranteed
blocks.text: We are a thoroughly vetted and endorsed enterprise backed by Google. The Google Guaranteed badge is an exclusive endorsement that not all companies can secure. Having undergone a comprehensive evaluation by Google, we have earned their esteemed badge, signifying our reliability and authenticity as a business.

blocks.label: Five-star backyard experiences
blocks.title:
Hear what our clients
have to say.

reviews.name: Jeff L.
reviews.quote: Having recently moved to a new area, we relied on a friend who highly recommended Island Life Custom Pools. We are so glad that we heeded their advice. Tim exceeded our expectations with the construction of our beautiful pool. He was extremely communicative, detail oriented and surrounded himself with quality subs. In addition, his passion for assisting us with aesthetics was greatly appreciated. In essence, we would highly recommend Tim and his team to create your own slice of paradise.

reviews.name: Sam M.
reviews.quote: We had an amazing experience with Island Life custom pools. Tim and team took amazing care in helping us develop and execute on our vision. We really wanted to build a pool and an outdoor space we could use year round to bring people together. The quality and craftsmanship of the final product exceed our expectations and we came in on time and on budget. I think what sets Tim apart as a builder is his superb communication skills. We were always given a thorough understanding each step of the way from design, to excavation, to the structure and fireplace, all the way to start up! The crews are top notch and all materials feel premium I would highly recommend Island Life Custom Pools.

reviews.name: Jasmine H.
reviews.quote: We had a wonderful experience using Island Life to build our pool, spa and fire pit. Tim and Jose were in constant communication with us with a weekly calendar to keep us updated every step of the way. Even the construction crews were very nice and polite. We are so impressed with how everything turned out. It is so beautiful and we are so happy with it. We highly recommend.

reviews.name: Annette
reviews.quote: Huge thanks to Island Life Custom Pools for converting our backyard into our own personal oasis. Tim (the owner) made the process very easy and stress free. He is an honest man who constantly kept his word and heard our every want/must haves and made it happen. Tim is very responsive and answered all calls and text fast. He knew how our dogs are spoiled and even made a cute trail for them! If you don’t know anything about pools, don’t worry, he walks you through every step of the way. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dee G.
reviews.quote: From the design to close-out, Tim and Eric were amazing! They addressed any issue big or small, listened to our needs and concerns and started working on them immediately. Our pool is beautiful. Making a large purchase like this can be a stressful time but Tim was patient and Eric new exactly what we wanted. We are so happy we chose Island Life Pools!!

questions.question: What does Island Life Custom Pools build?
questions.answer: We design and build custom swimming pools and spas, custom patios and patio covers, and outdoor kitchens. We also coordinate spas, fire pits, fireplaces, pickleball courts, and dependable Hayward equipment, so the whole backyard comes from one team.

questions.question: Which Greater Houston-area cities do you build pools in?
questions.answer: We design and build custom pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens in Tomball, Cypress, The Woodlands, Houston, Katy, Spring, Magnolia, and Jersey Village, Texas. Each city has its own page.

questions.question: Do you build pools in Cypress and Tomball?
questions.answer: Yes. Island Life Custom Pools designs and builds custom pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens for homes in Cypress and Tomball. Request a free quote and your free design consultation comes with it.

questions.question: What happens in the free design consultation?
questions.answer: Your quote request includes a free design consultation. We talk through your property, your priorities, and the next steps, so we understand what you would like to build before the design takes shape.

questions.question: Can I see my pool before it is built?
questions.answer: Yes. We create a 3D model of your pool and outdoor space, so you can see your vision come to life before construction begins.
questions.linkLabel: See the design software in action

questions.question: How much does a custom pool cost?
questions.answer: Every project is custom, so the cost depends on the size and shape of the pool, the features you choose, the equipment, and the rest of the backyard around it. After your free design consultation we provide a quote for your project. To plan a monthly payment, try the financing estimator.

questions.question: Do you offer financing?
questions.answer: We work with third-party lenders, including Lyon Financial and HFS Financial. You apply with the lender, which provides the final rates and terms.

questions.question: Do you offer discounts?
questions.answer: Military personnel, first responders, and teachers receive a generous discount.

questions.question: How do I request a quote?
questions.answer: Request a quote with the quote form on the Island Life Custom Pools home page, or call (832) 304-4092 (Monday–Friday 8am–7pm, Saturday 8am–12pm). A free design consultation comes with every quote request.

questions.question: Why choose Island Life Custom Pools as your pool builder?
questions.answer: We plan the pool, patio, and outdoor kitchen as one backyard and show it in a custom 3D model before construction begins. The company began in 2016, is owner-led by Justin Hall, and received the Best of Tomball Pool Builders Award (2018, 2019, 2020) and Best of Houzz 2020 (Service). Every quote request includes a free design consultation.

questions.question: Who owns Island Life Custom Pools?
questions.answer: Island Life Custom Pools is owner-led by Justin Hall. The company began in 2016.

questions.question: Has Island Life Custom Pools won any pool builder awards?
questions.answer: Yes. Island Life Custom Pools received the Best of Tomball Pool Builders Award in 2018, 2019, and 2020, and Best of Houzz 2020 (Service).
